posts.title: Coronagraph Watch
posts.text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — September 13, 2026

NASA’s DONKI logged a new coronal mass ejection, making the outer corona worth a look.

☀ CME start: September 13, 2026 at 21:12 UTC
💨 CME speed: 645 km/s
🏷 CME SCORE: C-type (500–999 km/s)
📐 CME half-angle: 22° (Moderate)
📍 Source: S10W10 (near disk center)
🌎 WSA-ENLIL Earth outlook: Glancing Earth impact modeled — estimated arrival September 17, 2026 at 12:00 UTC; possible Kp 2–4

I'm watching the corona today.

Image: NOAA SWPC — CCOR-1
Data: NASA DONKI + NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center

posts.title: Nighttime Sunwatch
posts.text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — September 13, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.2 (Peaked September 13, 2026 at 18:01 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 304 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)

Pretty quiet out there. 🌎

Today’s solar images show a few small sunspots, bright loop activity on the right side, and broad coronal-hole regions.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
